card.name: Adjective endings before a noun
card.fires_on: The ending or closing piece of an adjective such as decorative, ornamental, sacrificial, ceremonial, or diseased, and the word freshly. It fires in general web text when a noun like foliage, trees, animals or tanks comes next.

modes.label: Ending of -ative/-ial/-al adjectives
modes.description: The last piece of a longer descriptive adjective that is about to modify a noun.

modes.label: Freshly before a participle
modes.description: The word freshly placed before a participle like baked or painted, ahead of a food or object noun.
modes.example: a curious collection of<< freshly>> painted tanks, pumps and tubes.

card.writes: It suggests that a noun for an object or item comes next, but the promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and weak.
card.plain: It marks an adjective like ornamental or sacrificial that is about to describe a noun, such as trees or animals.
